# The First Three NIST Post-Quantum Standards Serve Two Distinct Purposes

The Secretary of Commerce approved FIPS 203, 204 and 205 in August 2024. The standards address two distinct tasks: establishing a shared secret between parties communicating over a public channel, and providing digital signature schemes.

FIPS 203 specifies ML-KEM for establishing a shared secret. FIPS 204 specifies a module-lattice-based digital signature scheme, while FIPS 205 specifies a stateless hash-based digital signature scheme. The schemes are designed to resist future quantum attacks.
